response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong senior-level software engineering credentials with 20 years of technical experience and appropriate seniority, he fundamentally lacks the specialized hardware and AI accelerator expertise essential for this Principal Performance Architect role. The position requires deep expertise in SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture optimization, and AI workload analysis—domains with no evidence in his resume. His career has been exclusively focused on software development, web platforms, and distributed systems rather than hardware systems engineering, silicon design, or AI accelerator optimization.
strengths: Strong seniority level with 20+ years of technical experience and proven principal/staff engineer credentials
Solid background in performance optimization, including low-latency systems and high-performance databases at scale
Demonstrated system architecture design skills and experience with hardware-adjacent work in embedded systems
concerns: No SoC or IP modeling experience—a core technical requirement for the role
Complete absence of GPU architecture, AI accelerator, or deep learning workload optimization background
Career entirely focused on software/web development rather than hardware systems engineering and semiconductor design
